notes: Andrew, 2026-10-26 (night): "I think we need something like a ruggable so that it's thin enough and separate from the padding to allow actually washing"; "What color / size for each room? tell me"; "oh nice, tumble rug is orderable on amazon! pretty convenient we should prefer that unless ruggable is way better or something"; "I need tumble rugs on amazon (use browser) with correct color / size for the rooms". The Amazon listing, read in Chrome 2026-10-26 (about 11 pm): its bullets say "Machine washable & spillproof rugs: All of Tumble's machine washable rugs feature a protective spillproof surface that allows liquids and oils to bead up" and "Complete rug & pad set included: Every Tumble area rug includes a cushioned 1/4-inch, non slip rug pad"; Material Polyester; Pile Height Low Pile. The maker's page (tumbleliving.com, same day): a 1/8" rug on a 1/4" EVA-and-TPR pad tucked into corner pockets, "All rug sizes fit into a standard household washer and dryer", cold wash, low dry, no robot vacuums ("known to damage the rug's edges"). Same prices as the maker's site (9x12 $549, 8x10 $399, 5x7 $199). Listing as read: Tumble Olivia Washable Area Rug | 9x12 Living Room Bedroom Area Rug, $549.00, Color Ivory/Neutral, In Stock; FREE delivery Tuesday, November 3. Maker's color notes: "Light ivory ground is more cool toned than warm toned and casts as a very light grey in certain lighting. Accents are white, taupe, khaki, & brown"; hand-drawn florals. THE PICK for the living room (F-68, F-69): a pale cool-ivory field lifts the dark gray MORABO and the walnut UGGLERUM off the honey oak; its taupe and khaki florals pick up the sage and off-white accents; sibling of the dining room's gray Canyon in one sightline. Footprint x 33 to 177, y 35 to 143 (rot 90), every leg of the sofa group on it. The other 9x12 Olivia (B0HCN21LSC) is Ash/Multi, darker and cooler, not taken.
